positions: a position is an integer count of microseconds from 0000-01-01T00:00:00 of the proleptic Gregorian calendar, on the UTC line for a value in a zone and on the floating line otherwise, and from the start of the cycle for a value with no year (the year's cycle for a month and day, the week's for a weekday); a span is [from, to], half-open; positions exceed 2^53 and are read as 64-bit integers
parts: a value is {value: units}, an interval of two values {span: [units, units]}, a recurrence {every: {count, from: units, cadence: units}}; units are [unit, held] pairs in the order written, coarsest first, built in the entry's calendar; held is a whole number (negative counts from the end), {set: [number or {range: [first, last]}]}, {mask: digits and X}, any, {fraction: [microseconds, places written]}, or for the unit zone a zone's name; text is what Tempo writes for the parts, for a port's reader, null where the parts are no value or the value has no text
